gold_sql:
SELECT ST_Value(rast, 1, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.363678 37.594847)',4326)) AS elevation
FROM public.dem_us
WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.363678 37.594847)',4326))
LIMIT 1;

```sql
WITH point_geom AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.363678 37.594847)'), 4326)::geography AS geom
)
SELECT 
  ST_Value(r.rast, p.geom::geometry) AS elevation
FROM 
  public.dem_us r,
  point_geom p
WHERE 
  ST_Intersects(r.rast, p.geom::geometry);
```
